text:
Maya (People Ops): hey everyone — follow-up thread from today's all-hands re: the org remap and where hiring capacity lands. please drop short q's here and we'll answer as we go. :wave:

Theo (VP Eng): quick context — primary goals for the remap: 1) consolidate infra/runtime teams for faster cross-model optimizations, 2) create two product-focused squads for Dedicated + Private, and 3) centralize onboarding for model ops. We plan staged moves over the next 8–12 weeks.

Zane (Eng Manager): timeline Q: for people affected by team moves, when will managers have official lists?

Maya (People Ops): managers will get the first wave of outreach next Tue (internal email + 1:1 templates). we'll also publish the team maps to the confluence page linked in the all-hands deck.

Priya (Product): question on scope — will product squads be aligned by customer segment (enterprise vs PLG) or by surface area (inference features)?

Theo (VP Eng): aligned by surface area. enterprise features like rollouts/SLA integrations will pair with Dedicated squad; PLG growth/experiments sit with Hosted API squad.

Raj (CTO): FYI on hiring: no company-wide freeze. we're prioritizing roles that unblock Biz KPIs (throughput, latency, reliability) and a small number of growth PM/AE headcounts. Expect incremental approvals, not a blanket headcount push.

Lisa (Talent Partner): process Q: if an IC wants to apply to a different squad internally, what's the process?

Emilia (Recruiting): internal mobility steps: 1) talk to your current manager + indicate interest in Workday internal req; 2) apply via internal link; 3) interview loop is typically 1–2 rounds. we encourage managers to support applicants.

Zane (Eng Manager): will compensation bands change for the new squads? some folks asked about leveling differences across infra vs product teams.

Maya (People Ops): comp bands remain company-wide. leveling rubric is unchanged — we'll publish examples specific to the new squads in the leveling doc by end of week.

Anonymous (via all-hands-bot): are any teams being reduced/headcount cuts planned? :worried:

Theo (VP Eng): no layoffs planned. we are reallocating where we invest. some roles will be de-prioritized in favor of infra and Dedicated reliability hires.

Priya (Product): operational question: how will rollouts work for teams that span Dedicated + Hosted?

Theo (VP Eng): we'll use cross-squad program leads and per-feature canaries. Console will get a new `rollout` dashboard to show per-route traffic and fallback counts.

Maya (People Ops): onboarding note — for people moving teams expect 2 weeks of overlap with outgoing manager for knowledge transfer. we'll provide a checklist and 1:1 templates.

Emilia (Recruiting): headcount numbers: FY target additions = ~18 FTEs this quarter (8 infra/serving, 6 product, 4 sales/CS). approvals will be staged.

Lisa (Talent Partner): operationally, if you're thinking about transferring, please flag your manager and cc me; we'll triage and run interviews without impacting your current performance review cycle.

Zane (Eng Manager): are there expected changes to oncall rotations after the remap?

Theo (VP Eng): yes — we'll rebalance oncall so infra engineers cover core runtime oncall while product squads have a separate feature oncall. details in eng-runbooks next week.

Maya (People Ops): final — if you want to be anonymous with feedback about the remap, drop into the anonymous form linked in the deck or DM me. we'll update this thread with the confluence links and the manager outreach timeline. :thumbsup:

all-hands-bot: recording uploaded: https://redwood-internal/recordings/all-hands-3129998888.mp4

Maya (People Ops): added links: confluence org map: https://redwood-internal/docs/org-remap and mobility playbook: https://redwood-internal/docs/internal-mobility — will post here when manager emails go out (target Tue).

Priya (Product): thanks y'all. appreciate the clarifications. :heart:

Zane (Eng Manager): noted, will prep team Q&A in next sync.

Emilia (Recruiting): ping me if you don't see the internal reqs after Tue and we'll escalate.

Maya (People Ops): closing the loop — last update will be by end of next week; if anything urgent please DM. thanks everyone for the questions.
